title: Stalk compatibility of a specified tensor pullback chain map
statement: Fix a cartesian square of schemes $X'\xrightarrow{g'}X$, $S'\xrightarrow g S$, $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$ and a point $z\in X'$. Use its actual stalk rings $R,A,B,C$ and the scalar-extension functor $F$ and stalk functors of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $P,Q$ be arbitrary complexes on $X$, $N$ an arbitrary complex on $X'$, and $a:H Q\to N$ a chain map, where $H$ is termwise module pullback. Suppose $\chi:H\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes HQ)$ restricts on every total-degree summand to the specified module pullback tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Write $U=P_{g'z}$, $V=Q_{g'z}$, and $t=\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(Q);S(a)$, with $S$ the stalk complex functor on $X'$ at $z$. There exist chain isomorphisms $\sigma:U\otimes V\cong(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q))_{g'z}$ and $\rho:F(U)\otimes S(N)\cong S(\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes N))$ such that $F(\sigma);\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q));S(\chi;(1\otimes a))=\mu_F^{-1};(1\otimes t);\rho$. No K-flatness, derived identification, boundedness, or horizontal invertibility is assumed.

proof.text: Take sigma from the inverse source stalk tensor comparison. Construct rho from tensorStalkIso(P) on the first factor followed by the inverse target stalk tensor comparison. The comparisons are chain isomorphisms by naturality, including the signed total differential.

For each total-degree summand, apply the assumed degreewise equation for chi. The generator formulas for the pinned module tensor-pullback map and pullback-stalk comparison, together with the scalar-extension tensorator formula, identify the two composites on each pure tensor with scalar extension of its first factor followed by the stalk of a in its second factor. Pure tensors generate each summand, and the coproduct universal property gives equality in every degree, hence equality of chain maps. Zero rings and zero factors give the unique maps; arbitrary direct sums handle unbounded complexes.

theorem exists_tensor_pullback_stalk_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ⟶ N)
    (χ : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (pullbackTensorTotal X P Q) ≅
      pullbackTensorTotal X'
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hχ : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').map
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫
        χ.hom.f n =
      ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.module_pullback_tensor g')) (P.X p) (Q.X q)).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
          (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) (z : X') :
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z))
    let R := SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z
    let A := SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' z
    let B := SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z
    let C := SingleComplexBaseChange.C z
    let F := (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C).comp
        (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let S := (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let U := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z P
    let V := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z Q
    let t := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z Q).hom ≫ S.map a
    ∃ (σ : U ⊗ V ≅ SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z
        (pullbackTensorTotal X P Q))
      (ρ : F.obj U ⊗ S.obj N ≅ S.obj
        (pullbackTensorTotal X'
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) N)),
      F.map σ.hom ≫
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z
            (pullbackTensorTotal X P Q)).hom ≫
          S.map (χ.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 _) a (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ)) =
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U V).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t) ≫ ρ.hom
